exploration.find: Base URL / port of the UI and API; reachable from the machine AND from the CI runner
API authentication (bearer token vs session cookie), header names, login response shape; payload field names for client / beneficiary / document calls
Is read-only database access available? Engine, schema / data dictionary
Which seeded users exist: new agent, second agent, MFA agent; which can be locked / reset safely (disposable)
Lockout behaviour (5th failure locks? duration / unlock) and session timeout length
How OTP is simulated (fixed code?) for login MFA and password reset
Exact password policy rules and the change / reset page route
Age 18 and 65 inclusive? Age calculated on which date?
Income vs premium affordability rule: block or warning, threshold, where it appears
Face value min / max per product, product eligibility by age, suitability mismatch example, exact Whole Life product names
Maximum rider count, age-restricted rider, which waiver riders are exclusive, rider names
Maximum upload size and which documents are mandatory
Can tests create their own draft applications (UI and API)? Is cleanup possible?
